title: Desvigne band personnel and hotel and club jobs
summary: He names band members, then the hotel, restaurant and country club jobs, including Monday nights on the Pythian roof garden.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Who else was in the band?
Oh the names, it's pretty hard for me to remember all those fellas. I can give you a few.
Any other trombone or trumpet player besides Sidney that you remember?
Eugene Ware and George Flemons. And they had Lewis Bobberin on drum. They had Ransom Norlins on bass. One year we used Loving Good. Another year we used Steve J. Lewis. And another year we used-
It was on Deanna, Steve Lewis.
Yeah, and then we used Professor Blanchett.
And we had, I just remember that guitar player, it was Rene Hall. Then we had Adolf Alexander on sax, Theodore Poinel, and Sam Dutre on tenor.
Was that young Sam Dutre or the old man?

The young Sam Dutre. The big fella, yeah. The young Sam Dutre. The big fella, yeah. The young Sam Dutre. And then after we finished playing on the captive, then we came out in the city. And we played for all the leading hotels in the city of New Orleans and all the restaurants, La Lusanne and all different, all those big high class restaurants, Sun Yacht Club, Jewish Country Club, Metric Country Club, and all those places like that. We only played one night a week for Colette and that was on the roof guard and that was every Monday night. We had that engagement.
Was that the Pelican or the other Pythian Temple?
That's the Pythian Temple. We called it the old roof guard. Yeah. Yeah.
